prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. Approach the object. If visible, take it, check its properties, and move to location. Then do a specific task. If not, scan area for the object. list of available nodes: <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Action ID = MoveToLocation    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <SubTree ID = SpecificTask    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		DO CheckObjectProperties
		DO MoveToLocation
		DO SpecificTask
	END
